name: Mula-Mutha river bridges, peak-hour classified volume counts (both directions)

source.title: Comprehensive Mobility Plan for Pune City, Pune Municipal Corporation (2008)
source.tables: Table 4.1 'Summary of Screen Line Counts (12hrs)', p. 4-3; annexure 'Summary of CVC collected across Screen line-2' (Table 8), PDF p. 163 (peak hour and its time, vehicles and PCU)
source.note: Mid-block classified volume counts, both directions together, 12 hours (08:00-20:00). The counts are about 18 years old: traffic has very likely grown since, and some bridges have been rebuilt or paired with new ones. They are an order-of-magnitude check on the model, not calibration targets.

matching: OSM ways of each bridge in the 2026-11-01 western-zone extract, matched by name; 'comparable: false' where the bridge has changed since 2008 (a parallel bridge now shares its traffic).

stations.name: Sambhaji Bridge (Lakdi Pul)
stations.note: No two-wheelers in the count: two-wheelers are not allowed on Lakdi Pul. The model does not apply vehicle-class bans.
